student_message: Just tell me what's wrong with my examples. 4 of my 5 examples are 'positive' and it keeps answering positive.

conversation_history.content: If zero-shot prompting fails on an edge-case task, how should you structure few-shot examples to guide the model effectively?
I gave it five examples but it labels almost everything positive.
Walk me through your reasoning. Why do you expect that to work?

analyzer_result.retrieval_query: few-shot label imbalance majority label bias

misconception_verdicts.misconception_label: Skewing few-shot exemplar distributions toward one class

lcc_evaluation.turn_note: Describes the skewed example set without linking it to the output.

retrieved_chunks.excerpt: Few-shot examples teach the model the input-output mapping. If most examples share one label, the model tends to predict that label, so balance the labels and include edge cases.
